item.description:

Their BNG coordinates are: Western boundary stile : 390183, 217786 Eastern boundary stile : 390196, 217824 These stiles provide the accurate line of passage through the farm and should be used in place of the incorrectly shown route.

item.title: Paving stone repaired by builders is a bodge, 26th September
item.description:

The initial repairs, replacing the paving stone with gravel. 3. The final repair showing the original paving stone replaced with 2 misshaped paving stones reducing the width of the pavement - when compared to the width before the work was done- and grass used to cover the space where the paving stone should be. The problem arose when the builders did the work several months ago.
